Container.Name: heddohon
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: navidrome subsonic jellyfin music player flac lossless lyrics radio scrobble
Container.Overview:
A music player for a Navidrome, Subsonic or Jellyfin library, rendered on the server.
Audio and artwork are fetched by Heddohon rather than by the browser, so the music server never has to be reachable from the devices you play on: one hostname is exposed and the library stays where it is. Sign-in is a live call to the music server, so there is no second set of accounts to keep.
Streams the original file by default, up to FLAC 24/192, with no transcoding or resampling, and shows what is being decoded. Transcoding to MP3, Opus or AAC is a setting of each account.
Synced lyrics, crossfade, a 10-band equaliser, ReplayGain, internet radio from the stations Navidrome lists, and a listening history with statistics, kept on this server. Links to songs, albums and playlists play without an account, and a link to listen together plays what the host plays. The queue and settings follow the account between devices, one browser can control another, and accounts that choose to can see what each other is playing. There is a phone layout, an installable app, and desktop apps for Linux and Windows.
Container.Requires:
Before the first start:
1. Secret. It encrypts the music-server credentials Heddohon stores. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 48. Changing it later signs everyone out.
2. At least one music server URL. It is resolved by the container, so a LAN address is the right answer: http://192.168.1.10:4533
3. Public URL. The address you open Heddohon at, exactly as the browser shows it: http://192.168.1.10:3000 on the LAN, or https://music.example.com behind a reverse proxy. Sign-in is refused from any other address.
4. Over plain http, set Secure cookie (under Advanced) to false, or the sign-in does not stick.
5. The appdata folder, owned by the user the container runs as. This template runs it as 99:100: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/heddohon && chown -R 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/heddohon. Where the folder is missing at the first start, Docker creates it owned by root, the container cannot write to it, and it reports itself unhealthy. With --user 99:100 removed from Extra Parameters the image runs as 1000:1000, and the folder is given to that user in the same way.
The database is SQLite in appdata. The PostgreSQL settings under Advanced move it to a PostgreSQL server, and can be left empty.
Every setting is described at https://github.com/zorcerer/heddohon/wiki/Configuration

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port the interface is served on.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Holds the cover cache and the log files, and the SQLite database unless a PostgreSQL URL is set.

Config.Name: Secret
Config.Description: Encrypts stored music-server credentials and derives session keys. Minimum 32 characters: openssl rand -base64 48. Changing it signs everyone out.

Config.Name: Navidrome / Subsonic URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Navidrome or Subsonic server, resolved by this container and not by the browser, such as http://192.168.1.10:4533. Leave empty if you only use Jellyfin.

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Jellyfin server, such as http://192.168.1.10:8096. Leave empty if you only use Navidrome.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address you open Heddohon at, exactly as the browser shows it, with its scheme and port: http://192.168.1.10:3000 on the LAN, or https://music.example.com behind a reverse proxy. Sign-in and every other change are refused from an address that does not match.

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: auto marks the session cookie Secure, which in this image is always, whatever the scheme. Set false if you reach this over plain http on the LAN, or sign-in will not stick.

Config.Name: Session hours
Config.Description: How long a sign-in lasts, in hours. 720 is 30 days. Not extended by activity.

Config.Name: Application name
Config.Description: Shown on the sign-in screen and in the sidebar.

Config.Name: Navidrome label
Config.Description: Name shown for this server on the sign-in screen.

Config.Name: Jellyfin label
Config.Description: Name shown for this server on the sign-in screen.

Config.Name: Sign-in hint
Config.Description: An optional line of text on the sign-in screen, for telling users which account to use.

Config.Name: Cover cache
Config.Description: Megabytes of cover art kept under the appdata path. The least recently used files are dropped once it is passed. 0 switches the cache off.

Config.Name: Upstream timeout
Config.Description: Milliseconds to wait on the music server before giving up. A stream has no limit once it has started.

Config.Name: Shared links
Config.Description: true lets accounts share a song, an album or a playlist by link, playable by anyone with the link for 1, 7 or 30 days, and start a session to listen together (which also needs Remote control). false hides the share buttons and stops existing links from opening; they open again if this is set back to true.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: The Download original link in the player's track details. false removes it and its route.

Config.Name: Remote control
Config.Description: The player's Devices button: control playback on another browser signed in to the same account and, with the Navidrome plugin, pick a track up from another app. false removes it and its routes, and with it Listening now and listening together.

Config.Name: Listening now
Config.Description: Lets accounts on this server see what each other is playing. An account is shown only after it turns this on under Settings, Account, where it also sets a display name and a picture. false removes it and its routes. Needs Remote control.

Config.Name: Folder view
Config.Description: The Folders page, which browses the library as it is laid out on disk. false removes the page, its links and playing a folder.

Config.Name: Internet radio
Config.Description: The Radio page, for the internet radio stations Navidrome lists. A station is played through this server, which fetches its stream. false removes it.

Config.Name: Radio stations on private addresses
Config.Description: true allows a station whose stream is on a private or loopback address, for a stream served on your own network. Otherwise such a station is refused.

Config.Name: Navidrome plugin token
Config.Description: Optional. Set it to let the Heddohon plugin for Navidrome (heddohon.ndp, from github.com/zorcerer/heddohon-navidrome-plugin) tell this server what is played in other apps: those plays go into the listening history, an import brings in the whole scrobble history, and the Devices button lists the other apps. At least 32 characters and not the Secret: openssl rand -hex 32. The plugin's settings in Navidrome take the same value. Empty leaves it off.

Config.Name: Lyrics from LRCLIB
Config.Description: true fetches lyrics from LRCLIB for tracks the music server has none for, sending the artist, title, album and length of each such track to LRCLIB when its lyrics are opened.

Config.Name: LRCLIB URL
Config.Description: The LRCLIB to ask. Filled in with lrclib.net; change it for a self-hosted one. Only read when Lyrics from LRCLIB is true.

Config.Name: Headphone corrections from AutoEq
Config.Description: true lets listeners search the AutoEq database for their headphones under Settings, Playback, Equaliser. The server fetches the index once a day and each correction chosen from GitHub, which learns this server's address and the headphones chosen.

Config.Name: AutoEq URL
Config.Description: AutoEq's results directory to read. Filled in with the one on GitHub; change it for a mirror. Only read when Headphone corrections from AutoEq is true.

Config.Name: Plays to a Discord channel
Config.Description: true lets an account paste a Discord webhook address under Settings, Account, and posts each track it plays to that channel. The server then sends the title, artist, album and cover of what that account plays to Discord.

Config.Name: ListenBrainz from this server
Config.Description: true lets each account paste a ListenBrainz user token of its own under Settings, Account, and scrobbles what it plays. The server then sends the title, artist and album of what that account plays to ListenBrainz. An account that linked ListenBrainz through Navidrome keeps that one instead.

Config.Name: ListenBrainz URL
Config.Description: The ListenBrainz API to send to. Filled in with listenbrainz.org; change it for a server of your own. Only read when ListenBrainz from this server is true.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: error, warn, info or debug. The default writes nothing while the server is working. debug times every call to the music server, for working out why a page is slow.

Config.Name: Log format
Config.Description: text writes key=value lines. json writes one JSON object a line, for a log collector.

Config.Name: Slow request, in milliseconds
Config.Description: A request that takes this long or longer is logged as request-slow, at the warn level. 0 switches that off.

Config.Name: Log files kept, in days
Config.Description: The log is also written to the logs folder in the data directory, one file a day. This is how many days of files are kept; older ones are deleted. 0 writes no files.

Config.Name: Android app fingerprints
Config.Description: Optional. The server already vouches for the released Android app, so it opens without an address bar. For an app you built and signed yourself, put its certificate's SHA-256 fingerprint here (several separated by commas).

Config.Name: PostgreSQL URL (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to keep the database as SQLite in appdata. Set to postgres://host:5432/database to keep it on a PostgreSQL server instead; an existing SQLite database is copied across on the first start.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL user (optional)
Config.Description: Optional, only with a PostgreSQL URL. The user, if it is not in the URL.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL password (optional)
Config.Description: Optional, only with a PostgreSQL URL. The password, if it is not in the URL.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL password file (optional)
Config.Description: Optional, only with a PostgreSQL URL. A file inside the container holding the password, in place of the variable above.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL TLS (optional)
Config.Description: Optional, only with a PostgreSQL URL. off, require (encrypted, certificate not checked) or verify-full. Empty uses the URL's sslmode.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL import (optional)
Config.Description: Optional, only with a PostgreSQL URL. true copies an existing SQLite database into an empty PostgreSQL one on the first start.
